playlist.playlist_description:
The Renovaré Institute for Christian Spiritual Formation is a two-year online and in-person school that provides students with a solid framework for understanding and living out Christian Spiritual Formation. For the first 3 years of the Institute, Dallas was able to teach 2 residency weeks per year. The theme of this course segment was "Living in the Divine Conversation and Character" or, more simply stated, "Hearing God."

We are grateful to our friends at Renovaré for allowing us to post this series on our channel. To learn more about the Institute, please visit https://renovare.org/institute.

Filmed March 15-18, 2011

Please refer to the “Renovare Institute Series” playlist for the October 2010 teachings.
